Figure 2: Multimodal feature heatmaps extracted from real and AI-generated video samples by CAM-VFD. Across all three modalities, real videos (left) exhibit strong cross-modal consistency, with coherent spatial structures, stable depth transitions, and physically plausible motion patterns reflecting underlying scene geometry. In contrast, AI-generated videos (right) expose distinctive inconsistency signatures: fragmented and spatially unstable appearance activations, geometrically incoherent depth transitions at subject boundaries, and abnormal motion energy concentrations at biologically unrealistic locations.
